train.via: Washington Union Station to Baltimore Penn Station

trips.route_note: Take a MARC Penn Line train or Amtrak from Union Station to Baltimore Penn Station, then walk or use the free Charm City Circulator to the Inner Harbor.
trips.tour_query: Baltimore day trip from Washington DC
trips.why: Frequent MARC and Amtrak trains from Union Station reach Baltimore Penn Station in about an hour, with the free circulator covering the last mile.
know: The Inner Harbor and Fell's Point are reachable via the free Charm City Circulator.
MARC Penn Line service is limited on weekends.
Book Amtrak ahead if you want a specific departure time.

trips.route_note: Take the Metro Yellow or Blue Line directly to King Street-Old Town station, then walk a few blocks to the waterfront historic district.
trips.tour_query: Alexandria Old Town day trip from Washington DC
trips.why: The Metro Yellow or Blue Line drops you directly at King Street-Old Town, steps from the waterfront historic district.
know: Old Town's King Street is walkable from the Metro station.
Weekends are lively but crowded along the waterfront.
Combine with a stroll to the Torpedo Factory art center.

bus.via: N CAPITOL ST & H ST nb to CALVERT ST & WEST ST fs nb

trips.route_note: Take a MARC Penn Line train or bus to New Carrollton, then a local bus to Annapolis, or drive; no direct train reaches downtown Annapolis.
trips.tour_query: Annapolis day trip from Washington DC
trips.why: No direct train reaches downtown Annapolis and the bus route requires a transfer, so driving is clearly better for this short 47-minute road trip.
know: The historic district and Naval Academy are best explored on foot once you park.
Weekends in spring and fall are busiest; arrive early for parking.
Many downtown sights cluster near the City Dock and Main Street.

bus.via: Washington Union Station to Fredericksburg Bus Stop

trips.route_note: Take a VRE Fredericksburg Line train or Amtrak from Union Station directly to Fredericksburg station, then walk or take a short local bus to the historic district.
trips.tour_query: Fredericksburg day trip from Washington DC
trips.why: The VRE/Amtrak train runs directly to Fredericksburg station with the historic district a short walk or local bus away.
know: VRE primarily runs on weekdays, so check the schedule for weekend trips.
The historic district is walkable from the station.
Allow time to explore the battlefield sites outside downtown.
